À **Paris**, l’annuaire met en avant plusieurs établissements qui proposent des parcours très demandés en **Master Informatique**, avec des spécialités variées (IA, data, cybersécurité, réseaux, logiciel).

* **Sorbonne Université** : AI2D (algorithmes/IA), MIND (machine learning), RES (réseaux/cyber/cloud), CCA & CCA-HPC (crypto/HPC), IMA (image/vision/graphique), STL (logiciel), SAR (systèmes répartis), BIM (bio-info), QI (quantum), et des voies en **apprentissage** sur certains parcours (ex. RES-ALT, SSI-ALT).
* **Université Paris Cité** : cybersécurité (dont apprentissage), données/algorithmes/analyse, ML (initiale et apprentissage), langages & programmation, vision & machine intelligente, master parisien de recherche en informatique, etc.
* **Université Paris sciences et lettres (PSL)** : parcours Informatique, Décision, Données (IDD – M1), avec un volume de candidatures élevé selon l’annuaire.
* **Université Paris 8** : Informatique & Big Data (selon les voies : initiale/continue et alternance), et Ingénierie en intelligence artificielle (initiale et alternance).

Pour comparer objectivement, regarde surtout **le nombre de places** et **le volume de candidats** : certains parcours dépassent largement le millier de candidatures pour quelques dizaines de places, ce qui augmente la sélectivité.

## Le master Informatique

Le master Informatique est un cursus en 2 ans. Dès la L3, les élèves doivent choisir une spécialisation pour le master. L’admission se fait sur dossier directement sur [Mon Master](https://www.monmaster.gouv.fr/). Afin d’intégrer ce master, il faut être titulaire issus des licences Informatique, Mathématiques et Informatique appliquées aux sciences humaines et sociales, Sciences pour l’Ingénieur, Électronique, énergie électrique, automatique et des BUT Informatique, Génie électrique et informatique industrielle.

Ce master a pour objectif de fournir les compétences nécessaires pour exercer des métiers dans les domaines de l’intelligence artificielle, du traitement des données, ou encore de la programmation.

### L’indicateur Thotis sur Mon Master

Thotis a mis en place cette année un indicateur visant à donner une idée de la sélectivité d’un établissement sur Mon Master. En effet, il n’est pas toujours évident d’analyser le nombre de candidats par rapport au nombre de places. * **De 6 % à 15 % → 💪💪💪**  
  *Très sélectif* : entre **6 % et 15 % des candidats** ont obtenu une proposition d’admission.
* **De 16 % à 30 % → 💪💪**  
  *Sélectif* : environ **1 candidat sur 3 à 6** a reçu une proposition d’admission.
* **De 31 % à 50 % → 💪**  
  *Sélectivité modérée* : entre **un tiers et la moitié des candidats** ont été admis.
* **De 51 % à 70 % → 💚**  
  *Accessible* : **plus d’un candidat sur deux** a reçu une proposition d’admission.
* **De 71 % à 90 % → 💚💚**  
  *Très accessible* : une **large majorité des candidats** a été admise.
* **De 91 % à 100 % → 💚💚💚**  
  *Quasi non sélectif* : **presque tous les candidats** ont reçu une proposition d’admission.

# Computer Science Program

![Computer Science Program](/sites/default/files/styles/actualite_full/public/pages/images/2020-09/Computer%20science.jpg?h=2acb40e2&itok=gXSFRfua)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Master | 2 Years - 120 ECTS |
| Course Start | September |
| Language | English |
| Location | Palaiseau Campus |

## Description

The Master of Computer Science is a two-year program designed for students interested in algorithms, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, human-computer interaction, networks, and systems. This selective program draws on IP Paris’s cutting-edge research laboratories and world-class researchers.

This program has a strong focus on research. The first year provides a solid foundation in key areas, while the second year offers the opportunity to specialize in one of several fields.

For students aiming to pursue a PhD after their master’s degree, the program is affiliated with three PhD track programs for early research immersion: one in Computer Science, another in Data & Artificial Intelligence, and one in Quantum Computing (within the PhD Track Quantum Science and Technologies). These PhD track programs offer excellence scholarships and registration fee waivers.

## Tracks

1. **Foundations of computer science, Operations research, Distributed computing, and Quantum computing (FODQ)**

This track focuses on the core components of Computer Science, ranging from theory and mathematics to applied distributed systems and quantum computing. Students have to choose one of the following 2-year majors:

* [Foundations of Computer Science (MPRI)](/en/education/institut-polytechnique-de-paris-masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-foundations-computer-science)
* [Operational Research (MPRO)](/en/education/institut-polytechnique-de-paris-masters/computer-science-program/master-2-recherche-operationnelle)
* [Parallel and Distributed Systems (PDS)](https://www.ip-paris.fr/en/education/masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-parallel-and-distributed-systems)
* [Quantum, Mathematics, Computer Science (QMI)](/en/education/masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-quantum-mathematics-computer-science)

1. **Cybersecurity, Cyberphysical Systems, and Networks (CCSN)**

This track addresses the main components of nowadays IT systems. It equips students with advanced technical skills and theoretical knowledge in securing digital infrastructures,formally designing and verifying intelligent cyber-physical systems, and optimizing modern network architectures. Students have to choose one of the following 2-year majors:

* [Computer Science for Networks (CSN)](/en/education/institut-polytechnique-de-paris-masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-computer-science-networks)
* [Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS)](/en/education/institut-polytechnique-de-paris-masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-cyber-physical-systems)
* [Cybersecurity (Cyber)](https://www.ip-paris.fr/en/education/masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-cybersecurity)

1. **Data, Artificial Intelligence, and Graphics (DAIIG)**

This track focuses on extracting information from data, and managing interactions with humans. These majors provide a balanced skill set, combining analytical rigor with creative problem-solving, for careers in AI research, data engineering, UX/UI design, or interactive media. Students have to choose one of the following 2-year majors:

* [Data and Artificial Intelligence (DataAI)](/en/education/masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-data-and-artificial-intelligence)
* [Interaction, Graphics and Design (IGD)](/en/education/institut-polytechnique-de-paris-masters/computer-science-program/master-year-2-interaction-graphics-design)

### PhD tracks

* [Computer Science](/en/education/phd-track/computer-science)
* [Data & Artificial Intelligence](/en/education/phd-track/data-artificial-intelligence)
* [Quantum Science and Technologies (QUANTIX)](/en/education/phd-track/phd-track-quantum-science-and-technologies-quantix)

## Objectives

This master's degree aims to enable students to:

* Master fundamental knowledge and tools in computer science before specialization;
* Master recent advanced research in various related domains;
* Apply scientific knowledge and concepts in original and personal research projects.

## General admission prerequisites

#### Academic prerequisites

* Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

#### Language prerequisites

* English (B2)

#### How to apply

Applications can be submitted exclusively online. You will need to provide the following documents:

* Transcript
* Two academic references (added online directly by your referees)
* CV/resume
* Statement of purpose highlighting your research interests and motivation for research

### Fees and scholarships

[Registration fees are available here](https://www.ip-paris.fr/en/education/masters/faqs)

[Find out more about scholarships](/education/bourses)

Please note that fees and scholarships may change for the following year.

## Applications and admission dates

[Admissions page](/en/education/admissions)

## Career opportunities

Upon completing the second year of the Master’s program, graduates will be well-equipped to pursue a PhD. They may also explore a wide range of career opportunities in academic or industrial research laboratories.

# Master Data AI

A Master in Computer Science at Institut Polytechnique de Paris

   

## Data AI 2026-2027

For new students, DataAI will start on Tuesday September 8, 2026, at 10:00 in room 0C03 of Telecom Paris with the [DataAI Basics course](https://suchanek.name/work/teaching/basics-2026/index.html) (obligatory for all new students).

The courses (for all students) start on September 14th.

## Overview

The DataAI study track is a two-year master’s program at the Institut Polytechnique de Paris to prepare students for a PhD. It is concerned with Artificial Intelligence (AI) and large-scale data management. To apply, you can browse the official IP Paris webpage for the [the M1](https://www.ip-paris.fr/education/masters/mention-informatique/master-year-1-data-and-artificial-intelligence) and for the [the M2](https://www.ip-paris.fr/education/masters/mention-informatique/master-year-2-data-and-artificial-intelligence).

The program is taught in English. It teaches students the basics of Machine Learning, Logic, Deep Learning, and Databases, before diving into applications in advanced machine learning, symbolic AI, natural language processing (language models), explainable and trustworthy AI, visual computing, and robotics. Students can choose from a wide variety of courses, collective intelligence, including on the reinforcement learning, multi-agent systems, graph mining, text mining, navigation for autonomous systems, the symbiosis of language models and structured data, AI reasoning, privacy-preserving data analysis, as well as social issues in AI.

The program has a focus on research, and aims to prepare students for a PhD. Therefore, it familiarizes students from the beginning with scientific work through scientific projects and internships.

* Language of instruction: English
* ECTS: 120
* Orientation: PhD
* Duration: 1 year (M2) or 2 years (M1+M2)
* Start: September
* Course Location: Quartier Polytechnique, Palaiseau, France

## Admissions

As this is a master's program, applicants need a Bachelor's degree or equivalent to apply. students should have a solid background in the basics of algorithms, math, and statistics. That said, we are open to diverse profiles as long as they can demonstrate their knowledge of math and computer science.

As courses are in English, the applicants need to justify their capacity to follow a course in English. We don't require a specific certificate or a specific grade but the candidate are encouraged to include a test (e.g. IELTS, TOEFL), be native speakers or have followed previous programs in English.

More information and the technical information to apply are available on the official IP Paris webpage for the [the M1](https://www.ip-paris.fr/education/masters/mention-informatique/master-year-1-data-and-artificial-intelligence) and for the [the M2](https://www.ip-paris.fr/education/masters/mention-informatique/master-year-2-data-and-artificial-intelligence).

If you have questions about the specific rules or organization of the Data AI master you can contact the master team at the address master-dataai

ip-paris.fr. If you have a question about the administrative aspects (application, etc.) you can contact master-admission

ip-paris.fr.

## Frequently Asked Questions

For questions related to the admission process at the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, please refer to the FAQ on the admission website: <https://www.ip-paris.fr/en/education/masters/faqs>.

* **Do I need a recommendation?** Yes, recommendation letters are important for us to know the candidates better. The only exception are for students coming from one of the IP Paris schools who can leave the recommendation empty (the system asks for a valid mail address but you can put not\_needed@ip-paris.fr).
* **Can I have a scholarship? Can you submit my name to the Eiffel scholarship?** The Data AI master does not have scholarships to offer nor does it submits names to scholarships. Students who wants to do research after the master are encouraged to apply directly to a PhD track program (it is a combined master + PhD program) where students can receive scholarships as well as funding for their PhD. The most relevant PhD track in IP Paris for Data AI students is the [Data AI PhD track](https://www.ip-paris.fr/en/education/phd-track/data-artificial-intelligence). More information about scholarships can be found on the IP Paris website [here](https://www.ip-paris.fr/en/education/scholarships).
* **I have a bachelor in economics/math/cs/biology can I still apply?** You can always apply and that is the only way to get an answer on whether you will be accepted but, as stated above, "following our program requires a solid background in both math and CS with a good knowledge of at least one programming language". If the jury fears that you don't have the required background they will not accept you. Note that CS is not just coding.
* **Can I still apply if I have two bachelors/a bachelor and a master/two masters/ a bachelor from 10 years ago?** You can always apply if you have at least one bachelor (see question above).
* **What should I put in my motivation letter (a.k.a. statement of purpose)?** A motivation letter should demonstrate your motivation and therefore there is not one good answer as the best motivation letter will be different for different applicants. Here are some important information that the jury is generally looking for: why did you apply to our master? what do you plan on doing after the master (long and short terms), e.g. are you planning on doing a PhD? are there specific topics that interest you? do you have experience with research? if you have a background not in CS, how do you plan on catching up?   
   The length of the motivation letter can vary on what the candidate has to say but generally one page is enough.
* **I have an average of ... at university ..., would I be selected?** Only the jury can get a definitive answer so one would need to actually apply to get an answer. We receive a lot of applications, much more than the number of positions that we have to offer and therefore the master is highly selective. We cannot give a "grade threshold" on acceptance as different countries, different universities and even sometimes different curricula have different grading scales or different grading systems. Furthermore, acceptance relies on more than just an average and on more than just grades.
* **Should I apply to the M1 or the M2?** The Bachelor's degree is followed by the first Master year (M1) and the second Master year (M2). Thus, if you have just a Bachelor's degree (or will have one by September this year), apply to M1. If you have already studied for one more year after the Bachelor's degree (and have earned 240 ECTS in total, or will have obtained this number of credits by September this year), you can apply to the M2. If you have doubts you can apply to both the M1 and the M2. In any case, the jury will determine your admissibility. If you already hold a master degree please state in your personal statement why you need a second one (as opposed to applying to a PhD directly).
* **When can I apply?** Admission dates can be found on the IP Paris website. If the dates for next year are not already published it is because we don't already have them but the dates for the current year should give a good estimate.
* **What is the admission timeline?** The admission proceeds in sessions (see here for the session dates: [www.ip-paris.fr/en/education/admissions](https://www.ip-paris.fr/en/education/admissions)). As soon as a session opens, the student can submit their application. As soon as the session closes, applications to this session are no longer possible. The applicants are then sent a supplementary questionnaire to gather further information. *Please watch out for this email in the week after the session closes, and answer it!* The jury then examines the applications, and it needs around 2 months. *As we receive hundreds of applications per session, please refrain from intermediary inquiries.* Just wait, and you will be notified of acceptance or rejection. In case of acceptance, you can request a letter of acceptance that you can use for visa applications.
* **When do the course start?** Courses generally start on the first week of September.
* **What are the fees?** You can consult the fees for Data AI on the IP Paris website in the [section FAQ for the masters](https://www.ip-paris.fr/education/masters/faq) or directly [here (for 2024)](https://www.ip-paris.fr/sites/default/files/pages/documents/Masters/master-phd-track-registration-fees-2024-EN-04-07-24-v2.pdf). Note that Data AI falls in the "international master" category.

* **Can do follow the program in "alternance"? Can I do the program while I am working for a company?** The program is meant to be a full time occupation. We don't offer "alternance" and we strongly advise against having a part time or a full time job on the side.

## Institutional partners

* ENSTA Paris
* École Polytechnique
* Télécom Paris
* Télécom SudParis

Each course of the program takes place in exactly one of these schools, all schools offer at least one course of the program, and all schools are located at the same campus in the city of Palaiseau in France, just south of Paris. The final diploma will be delivered by Institut Polytechnique de Paris.

The French National Master’s Degree is an internationally recognized degree awarded on behalf of the French State, distinct from non-national institution-specific degrees awarded independently by individual institutions.

### **Application dates via the IP Paris application portal**

* **1st session:** from October 29, 2025 to January 8, 2026
* **2nd session:** from January 9, 2026 to March 26, 2026
* **3rd session\*:** from March 27, 2026 to May 28, 2026

\* Please note: the following programs will not be open for the third session:

       M1 Cyber – Cybersecurity  
       M1 et M2 DataAI – Data and Artificial Intelligence  
       M1 et M2 CSN – Computer Science for Networks  
       M1 et M2 MiE – Master in Economics

For applications submitted via the national **MonMaster platform of the French Ministry of Higher Education and Research (MESR), applications will be open from February 17, 2026 to March 16, 2026**. For more information about their calendar, please visit their website by [clicking here](https://www.monmaster.gouv.fr/calendrier)

### **Prerequisites**

#### **Academic prerequisites**

* Admission to the **first year of a Master’s degree** is open to candidates holding (or in the process of obtaining) a Bachelor’s degree in the targeted field or a related discipline.
* Admission to the second year of a Master’s degree is reserved for candidates who have completed (or are in the process of completing) a first year of a Master’s degree.

General selection principles apply across all programs:

* **enrollment at a highly ranked university**, based on national rankings and/or the international QS rankings;
* **outstanding academic performance**, assessed according to the standards of the applicant’s home country and institution;
* **demonstrate an excellent academic background**, degree and a personal and professional project aligned with the chosen program.

#### **Language prerequisites**

* Applicants must demonstrate a strong level of English, generally B2 to C1, depending on the program applied for.
* A good level of French is also required for programs taught in French.

### **Application procedure**

Applications are submitted exclusively online and are file-based. Applicants will be required to provide the following documents:

* Degrees and academic transcripts;
* Two academic references (please note that it is the applicant’s responsibility to ensure that referees submit their references online);
* Curriculum Vitae (CV);
* Motivation letter;
* Additional specific documents may be required depending on the chosen program.

For further information, please consult the [FAQ](https://www.ip-paris.fr/education/masters/faq) or contact us at [master-admission@ip-paris.fr](mailto:master-admission@ip-paris.fr)
